verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application hosting platform, not an AI agent or client that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it to use their tools is a category error for this product type. The evidence covers only Render's own MCP server, which serves Render tools to external AI apps such as Claude Code and Cursor. That is the server role and does not count as MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
